Question B-001-010-008.

Why the correct answer is right: The 902 MHz to 928 MHz band is the one where amateur operations are not protected from interference by another service.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "144 MHz to 148 MHz": The 2-metre band has a 30 kHz bandwidth limit in B-001; it is not the reduced-protection range named here.
- sourceIndex 2: "222 MHz to 225 MHz": This amateur VHF range is not the one identified for unprotected operation from another service.
- sourceIndex 3: "50 MHz to 54 MHz": The 6-metre band has a 30 kHz bandwidth limit in B-001; it is not the reduced-protection range named here.
